# Attributing artifacts that were built earlier needs no compiler: the SASS
# and the PTX are read as they are, and the unit says what the lines mean.
exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_gate.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.cu
stdout 'fused_gate: 37 of 168 SASS instructions name a program line'
stdout 'kernels.go:14'

# The unit's own JSON form says the same, and carries the callers as well.
exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_gate.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.json
stdout 'kernels.go:14'

# SASS that names no unit's lines attributes nothing, and says so rather
# than printing an empty table.
exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_gate.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_gate.ptx $TESTDATA/fused_layered.cu
stdout 'fused_layered'

# A file that is not there is an error, not an empty report.
! exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/missing.sass $TESTDATA/fused_gate.cu
stderr 'no such file'
